vocabulary_rule: "contribution" for this three-way split (never "channel" — "channel" is reserved for the full/matched/pure readouts of §2). docs/PRIMER_BIAS_CHANNELS_20260822.md §3.

contributions.label: impostor drag
contributions.what: catalogue candidates that are NOT the true host sit at low z and drag h down
contributions.quote: Setting L_cat_no_bh ≡ 0 (exact subtraction) moves the 12-seed fleet from −0.1083 to −0.0291. Positive in 12/12 seeds (+0.030…+0.164).

contributions.label: dark-fraction tilt
contributions.what: a composition effect of the catalogue/dark mixture
contributions.quote: The tilt is measured at −0.133/h per event (ln D̃/β̄_G), ≈ −24 nats/h per seed, and owns the pure−matched gap (+0.025…+0.085, width-dependent).

contributions.label: matched-channel violation
contributions.what: the completion leg's own broken S̄_φ pairing

sum_note: The three contributions are independently measured, control-referenced quantities — not algebraic terms of one identity — so they need not sum to the headline exactly. Naive sum here: -0.1088 vs headline -0.1083 (difference -0.0005).

restored_arm_null.what: Restoring the registered arm (the S̄_φ zero-extension the executed arm had dropped) nulls the matched-channel score — the mechanism measurement, not a fourth contribution.

mechanism.cause: the off-cell completion numerator (B_num) omits the S̄_φ survival factor its normalizer (β̄_G_φ) carries — the legacy pre-#118 cell every run-of-record stood on
mechanism.fix: selection_in_completion_numerator = "fused" (B_num carries S̄_φ) — the pin for future runs; historical runs-of-record stand on "off"

source.method: hand-authored from quoted ledger rows, precedent = gen_ch11.py's I11.2 BOARD table; every value re-grep-able at the cited row
